title: Outlaw's Accessories
description: This mod adds several new items which can be equipped for benefits.
body:
# Outlaw's Accessories

## About
This mod adds 19 new items which can be equipped in a new menu with 3 slots.
Once I get 20 followers, I will release a major update with tons of new content!
Here I will give a short description of some of the items.

## Items


![Accessories](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b480b2e1c652308c62a1262b4330604a02384c05.png)


### Magic Scroll
The Magic Scroll increases XP earned by 1. You can equip multiple scrolls and get a higher bonus.

### Lucky Rabbit's Foot
The Lucky Rabbit's Foot grants a 10 percent chance to dodge attacks, making them deal no damage. It can also stack for a higher chance.

### Large Emerald
The Large Emerald grants permanent Hero of the Village I.

### Totem of Friendship
The Totem of Friendship is an upgrade of the Large Emerald, granting permanent Hero of the Village II.

### Quiver
The Quiver grants arrows when you press the Use Quiver keybind (default X). Doing this removes durability, which replenishes when you collect XP.

### Ancient Skull
The Ancient Skull grants +30% damage while under 3 hearts. It can be found in a new structure which spawns in jungle biomes.

### Emblems
Emblems are accessories which boost a certain class. So far, there are three kinds: Miner Emblem, Warrior Emblem, and Lumberjack Emblem. Each emblem has three levels. It can be upgraded by crafting it with various items.

## Stats Menu
There is a new menu which shows your stats, such as damage bonus, lifesteal, and blocks mined. It can be opened with the Stats Menu keybind (default Z).


## Keybinds
The keybinds for this mod are:

Open Accessories Menu: R

Use Quiver: X

Open Stats Menu: Z

## Planned Updates
Soon, I am planning to add a new emblem. I will also release more mods with more accessories.
